An older child’s availability is not a substitute for the support the adults have agreed to provide. Check whether the format works for your sibling and who, if anyone, has agreed to help make it happen. The familiar meal preparation Choose a task within the person’s current food and safety arrangements: selecting plates, gathering an agreed ingredient or setting the table.
